evidence_quotes.agenda: 'Before I proceed, I just like to ask you Michael if you have any concern about the moving process or let's see any worries that you'd like to talk about' — asked before any logistics probing. Full credit.
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: Customer answered no real concern (repeat customer, comfortable) — 15/15 via the no-concern-raised exception.
evidence_quotes.save_your_ass: 'If ever the move takes less than this you will only be charged for how much time we used' present; missing rate/experience, self-prep tip, fair-check.

top_strength: Warm, personalized handling of a repeat customer — referenced the prior move for comparison, thanked him for returning, and closed with genuine warmth.
coaching_note: Add the four differentiators (damage coverage, meet-your-mover, on-time, communication) — none appeared despite an otherwise excellent discovery-to-close flow.
